case.pattern_description: The undocumented pattern involves structuring multiple online purchases within an hour, each kept just under the $500 threshold to evade authorization limits. It affects repeat customers with prior fraud histories and was found through Sentinel near-threshold sweeps and graph analysis.

case.summary: Case SEN-010 was initiated on 2016-11-23 following a Sentinel sweep on card C01890-K1, which executed four online purchases totaling $1,921.59 within 27 minutes. Graph analysis confirmed a fraud probability of 0.90 due to structuring tactics keeping amounts just under the $500 threshold. Although the closed-case classifier scored the flagged transaction 3481444 at 0.21, the customer has four earlier confirmed fraud cases (CC-0351, CC-1608, CC-4983, CC-2368). The final actions include blocking the card via L1, creating a case automatically, and filing a report via L2 under §3a.

sar.narrative: Customer C01890 utilizing card C01890-K1 is the subject of this suspicious activity report. A total of four transactions amounting to $1,921.59 were executed across the account. The activity occurred on 2016-11-23 between 18:00:00 and 18:27:00. The transactions were conducted via online channels with billing region 284.0. The perpetrator utilized a new device profile, Moto E (4) Plus Build/NMA26.42-69 |  | chrome generic |, to perform rapid successive purchases. The activity is suspicious due to structuring amounts just under $500 and the customer's prior fraud history. Connected cards and devices were evaluated during the investigation. Recommended actions include blocking the card, creating a case, and filing a formal report.
